field_edits.updated_text: Near-complete resolution of previously noted marrow edema/bone contusions involving the acetabular walls, femoral head, femoral neck, and greater trochanter. No subchondral collapse, fracture, or new osseous abnormality. No acute fracture, avascular necrosis, or aggressive osseous lesion. Normal marrow signal is demonstrated.
Minimal residual hip joint effusion is present, markedly decreased compared to the prior study. No trochanteric bursitis.
